Chapter 20

Network PoliciesNetworkPolicy

The uniqueness of the IP address assigned to a Pod is maintained across all nodes and namespaces. This is accomplished by allocating a dedicated subnet to each registered node during its creation. The Container Network Interface (CNI) plug-in handles the leasing of IP addresses from the assigned subnet when a new Pod is created on a node. Consequently, Pods on a node can seamlessly communicate with all other Pods running on any node within the cluster.

分配给 Pod 的 IP 地址在所有节点和 namespace 之间都保持唯一。这是通过在每个注册节点创建时为其分配一个专属子网来实现的。当节点上创建新 Pod 时，Container Network Interface（CNI）插件负责从所分配的子网中租约 IP 地址。因此，一个节点上的 Pod 可以与集群中任意节点上运行的所有其他 Pod 无缝通信。

By default, Kubernetes allows unrestricted Pod-to-Pod communication across all namespaces, which poses a significant security risk, as a compromised Pod in one namespace could potentially access sensitive services in another namespace.

默认情况下，Kubernetes 允许跨所有 namespace 无限制地进行 Pod 间通信，这构成了显著的安全风险：某个 namespace 中被攻陷的 Pod 可能访问另一个 namespace 中的敏感服务。

Network policies in Kubernetes function similarly to firewall rules, specifically designed for governing Pod-to-Pod communication. These policies include rules specifying the direction of network traffic (ingress and/or egress) for one or multiple Pods within a namespace or across different namespaces. Additionally, these rules define the targeted ports for communication. This fine-grained control enhances security and governs the flow of traffic within the Kubernetes cluster.

Kubernetes 中的 NetworkPolicy 与防火墙规则类似，专门用于管控 Pod 间通信。这些策略包含规则，用于指定一个或多个 Pod 在同一 namespace 内或跨不同 namespace 的网络流量方向（ingress 和/或 egress）。此外，这些规则还定义了通信所针对的端口。这种细粒度控制增强了安全性，并治理了 Kubernetes 集群内的流量流向。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Define and enforce Network Policies.

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：定义并执行 NetworkPolicy。

Working with Network Policies使用 NetworkPolicy

Within a Kubernetes cluster, any Pod can talk to any other Pod without restrictions using its IP address or DNS name, even across namespaces. Not only does unrestricted inter-Pod communication pose a potential security risk, it also makes it harder to understand the mental communication model of your architecture. A network policy defines the rules that control traffic from and to a Pod, as illustrated in Figure 20-1.

在 Kubernetes 集群中，任何 Pod 都可以使用 IP 地址或 DNS 名称无限制地与任何其他 Pod 通信，即使跨 namespace 也如此。无限制的 Pod 间通信不仅带来潜在安全风险，还让人更难理解架构在心智上的通信模型。NetworkPolicy 定义了控制进出 Pod 的流量的规则，如图 20-1 所示。

— PDF p.281 —

For example, there’s no good reason to allow a backend application running in a Pod to talk directly to the frontend application running in another Pod. The communication should be directed from the frontend Pod to the backend Pod.

例如，没有充分理由允许运行在某个 Pod 中的后端应用直接与运行在另一个 Pod 中的前端应用通信。通信应当从前端 Pod 指向后端 Pod。

Installing a Network Policy Controller安装 NetworkPolicy 控制器

A network policy cannot work without a network policy controller. The network policy controller evaluates the collection of rules defined by a network policy. You can find instructions for a wide range of network policy controllers in the Kubernetes documentation. Some CNIs like flannel do not include a network policy controller and focus solely on providing basic Pod-to-Pod connectivity, meaning NetworkPolicy resources will be accepted by the API but completely unenforced.

NetworkPolicy 离开 NetworkPolicy 控制器就无法生效。NetworkPolicy 控制器评估 NetworkPolicy 所定义的规则集合。Kubernetes 文档中可以找到多种 NetworkPolicy 控制器的安装说明。某些 CNI（如 flannel）不包含 NetworkPolicy 控制器，只专注于提供基本的 Pod 间连通性，这意味着 NetworkPolicy 资源会被 API 接受，但完全不会被强制执行。

Cilium is a CNI that implements a network policy controller. You can install Cilium on cloud-provider and on-prem Kubernetes clusters. Refer to the installation instructions for detailed information. Once it is installed, you should find at least two Pods running Cilium and the Cilium Operator in the kube-system namespace:

Cilium 是一种实现了 NetworkPolicy 控制器的 CNI。你可以在云厂商和本地部署的 Kubernetes 集群上安装 Cilium。详细信息请参考安装说明。安装完成后，你应该能在 kube-system namespace 中找到至少两个运行 Cilium 和 Cilium Operator 的 Pod：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system
NAME                               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS       AGE
cilium-k5td6                       1/1     Running   0              110s
cilium-operator-f5dcdcc8d-njfbk    1/1     Running   0              110s

You can now assume that the rules defined by network policy objects will be evaluated. Additionally, you can use the Cilium command-line tool to validate the proper installation.

现在你可以认为 NetworkPolicy 对象所定义的规则会被评估。此外，你还可以使用 Cilium 命令行工具来验证安装是否正确。

Creating a Network Policy创建 NetworkPolicy

Label selection plays a crucial role in defining which Pods a network policy applies to. We’ve already seen this concept in action in other contexts (e.g., the Deployment and the Service). Furthermore, a network policy defines the direction of the traffic to allow or disallow. In the context of a network policy, incoming traffic is called ingress, and outgoing traffic is called egress. For ingress and egress, you can allowlist the sources of traffic like Pods, IP addresses, or ports.

标签选择在定义 NetworkPolicy 作用于哪些 Pod 时起着关键作用。我们已经在其他场景（如 Deployment 和 Service）中见过这一概念。此外，NetworkPolicy 定义了允许或禁止的流量方向。在 NetworkPolicy 的语境中，入站流量称为 ingress，出站流量称为 egress。对于 ingress 和 egress，你可以把流量来源（如 Pod、IP 地址或端口）加入白名单。

— PDF p.282 —
Network policies do not apply to ServicesNetworkPolicy 不适用于 Service

In most cases, you’d set up Service objects to funnel network traffic to Pods based on label and port selection. Network policies do not involve Services at all. All rules are namespace- and Pod-specific.

在大多数情况下，你会设置 Service 对象，基于标签和端口选择把网络流量导流到 Pod。NetworkPolicy 完全不涉及 Service，所有规则都是针对 namespace 和 Pod 的。

The creation of network policies is best explained by example. Let’s say you’re running a Pod that exposes an API to other consumers, for example, a Pod that processes payments for other applications. The company you’re working for is migrating applications from a legacy payment processor to a new one. Therefore, you’ll want to allow access only from the applications that are capable of properly communicating with it. Right now, you have two consumers—a grocery store and a coffee shop—each running their application in a separate Pod. The coffee shop is ready to consume the API of the payment processor, but the grocery store isn’t. Figure 20-2 shows the Pods and their assigned labels.

NetworkPolicy 的创建最好通过例子来解释。假设你运行了一个 Pod，向其他消费者暴露 API，例如一个为其他应用处理支付的 Pod。你所在的公司正在把应用从旧的支付处理器迁移到新的支付处理器，因此你希望只允许那些能与之正常通信的应用访问它。现在你有两个消费者——一家杂货店和一家咖啡店——各自在独立的 Pod 中运行应用。咖啡店已经准备好使用该支付处理器的 API，但杂货店还没有。图 20-2 展示了这些 Pod 及其所分配的标签。

Before creating a network policy, we’ll stand up the Pods to represent the scenario:

在创建 NetworkPolicy 之前，我们先起几个 Pod 来模拟该场景：

$ kubectl run grocery-store --image=nginx:1.25.3-alpine \
  -l app=grocery-store,role=backend --port 80
pod/grocery-store created
$ kubectl run payment-processor --image=nginx:1.25.3-alpine \
  -l app=payment-processor,role=api --port 80
pod/payment-processor created
$ kubectl run coffee-shop --image=nginx:1.25.3-alpine \
  -l app=coffee-shop,role=backend --port 80

Given Kubernetes’ default behavior of allowing unrestricted Pod-to-Pod communication, the three Pods will be able to talk to one another. The following commands verify the behavior. The grocery store and coffee shop Pods perform a wget call to the payment processor Pod’s IP address:

鉴于 Kubernetes 默认允许无限制的 Pod 间通信，这三个 Pod 将能够相互通信。以下命令验证了这一行为。杂货店和咖啡店的 Pod 对支付处理器 Pod 的 IP 地址执行 wget 调用：

$ kubectl get pod payment-processor --template '{{.status.podIP}}'
10.244.0.136
$ kubectl exec grocery-store -it -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.136
Connecting to 10.244.0.136 (10.244.0.136:80)
remote file exists
$ kubectl exec coffee-shop -it -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.136
Connecting to 10.244.0.136 (10.244.0.136:80)
remote file exists
— PDF p.283 —

You cannot create a new network policy with the imperative create command. Instead, you will have to use the declarative approach. The YAML manifest in Example 20-1, stored in the file networkpolicy-api-allow.yaml, shows a network policy for the scenario described previously.

你不能用命令式的 create 命令创建新的 NetworkPolicy，而必须使用声明式方式。示例 20-1 中的 YAML manifest 存放在文件 networkpolicy-api-allow.yaml 中，展示了针对上述场景的 NetworkPolicy。

Example 20-1. Declaring a NetworkPolicy with YAML

示例 20-1. 用 YAML 声明 NetworkPolicy

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: api-allow
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-processor
      role: api
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: coffee-shop
  • Selects the Pod the policy should apply to by label selection通过标签选择来选定该策略应作用于哪个 Pod
  • Allows incoming traffic from the Pod with matching labels within the same namespace允许来自同一 namespace 中、具有匹配标签的 Pod 的入站流量

A network policy defines a couple of important attributes, which together form its set of rules. Table 20-1 shows the attributes on the spec level.

NetworkPolicy 定义了若干重要属性，它们共同构成其规则集合。表 20-1 展示了 spec 层级的属性。

AttributeDescription
podSelectorSelects the Pods in the namespace to apply the network policy to.
podSelector在 namespace 中选定要应用该 NetworkPolicy 的 Pod。
policyTypesDefines the type of traffic (i.e., ingress and/or egress) the network policy applies to.
policyTypes定义该 NetworkPolicy 所作用的流量类型（即 ingress 和/或 egress）。
ingressLists the rules for incoming traffic. Each rule can define from and ports sections.
ingress列出入站流量的规则；每条规则可以定义 from 和 ports 部分。
egressLists the rules for outgoing traffic. Each rule can define to and ports sections.
egress列出入站流量的规则；每条规则可以定义 to 和 ports 部分。

You can specify ingress and egress rules independently using spec.ingress.from[] and spec.egress.to[]. Each rule consists of a Pod selector, an optional namespace selector, or a combination of both. Table 20-2 lists the relevant attributes for the to and from selectors.

你可以使用 spec.ingress.from[] 和 spec.egress.to[] 独立指定 ingress 和 egress 规则。每条规则由一个 Pod 选择器、一个可选的 namespace 选择器，或两者的组合构成。表 20-2 列出了 to 和 from 选择器的相关属性。

— PDF p.284 —
AttributeDescription
podSelectorSelects Pods by label(s) in the same namespace as the network policy that should be allowed as ingress sources or egress destinations.
podSelector按标签在与 NetworkPolicy 同一 namespace 中选择 Pod，这些 Pod 应被允许作为 ingress 来源或 egress 目的地。
namespaceSelectorSelects namespaces by label(s) for which all Pods should be allowed as ingress sources or egress destinations.
namespaceSelector按标签选择 namespace，这些 namespace 中的所有 Pod 都应被允许作为 ingress 来源或 egress 目的地。
namespaceSelector and podSelectorSelects Pods by label(s) within namespaces by label(s).
namespaceSelector 与 podSelector 组合按标签选择 namespace 内、再按标签选择其中的 Pod。

Let’s see the effect of the network policy in action. Create the network policy object from the manifest:

下面来看 NetworkPolicy 的实际效果。从 manifest 创建 NetworkPolicy 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f networkpolicy-api-allow.yaml
networkpolicy.networking.k8s.io/api-allow created

The network policy prevents calling the payment processor from the grocery store Pod. Accessing the payment processor from the coffee shop Pod works perfectly, as the network policy’s Pod selector matches the Pod’s assigned label app=coffee-shop:

该 NetworkPolicy 阻止了从杂货店 Pod 调用支付处理器。从咖啡店 Pod 访问支付处理器则完全正常，因为 NetworkPolicy 的 Pod 选择器匹配了该 Pod 所分配的标签 app=coffee-shop：

$ kubectl exec grocery-store -it -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.136
Connecting to 10.244.0.136 (10.244.0.136:80)
wget: download timed out
command terminated with exit code 1
$ kubectl exec coffee-shop -it -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.136
Connecting to 10.244.0.136 (10.244.0.136:80)
remote file exists

As an administrator, you may be dealing with network policies that have been set up for you by other team members or administrators. You need to know about the kubectl commands for listing and inspecting network policy objects to understand their effects on the directional network traffic between microservices.

作为管理员，你可能会面对其他团队成员或管理员为你设置好的 NetworkPolicy。你需要掌握列出和检查 NetworkPolicy 对象的 kubectl 命令，以理解它们对微服务之间有方向网络流量的影响。

Listing Network Policies列出 NetworkPolicy

Listing network policies works the same as any other Kubernetes primitive. Use the get command in combination with the resource type networkpolicy, or its short-form, netpol. For the previous network policy, you see a table that renders the name and Pod selector:

列出 NetworkPolicy 的方式与其他 Kubernetes 原语相同：使用 get 命令并配合资源类型 networkpolicy，或其简写 netpol。对于前面那个 NetworkPolicy，你会看到一张表，展示其名称和 Pod 选择器：

$ kubectl get networkpolicy api-allow
NAME         POD-SELECTOR                     AGE
api-allow    app=payment-processor,role=api   83m

It’s unfortunate that the output of the command doesn’t give a lot of information about the ingress and egress rules. To retrieve more information, you have to dig into the details.

遗憾的是，该命令的输出并没有给出太多关于 ingress 和 egress 规则的信息。要获取更多信息，必须深入查看详情。

— PDF p.285 —

Rendering Network Policy Details查看 NetworkPolicy 详情

You can inspect the details of a network policy using the describe command. The output renders all the important information: Pod selector, and ingress and egress rules:

你可以使用 describe 命令检查 NetworkPolicy 的详情。输出会展示所有重要信息：Pod 选择器，以及 ingress 和 egress 规则：

$ kubectl describe networkpolicy api-allow
Name:         api-allow
Namespace:    default
Created on:   2024-01-10 09:06:59 -0700 MST
Labels:       <none>
Annotations:  <none>
Spec:
  PodSelector:     app=payment-processor,role=api
  Allowing ingress traffic:
    To Port: <any> (traffic allowed to all ports)
    From:
      PodSelector: app=coffee-shop
  Not affecting egress traffic
  Policy Types: Ingress

The network policy details don’t draw a clear picture of the Pods that have been selected based on its rules. You can create Pods that match the rules and do not match the rules to verify the network policy’s desired behavior.

NetworkPolicy 的详情并不能清晰地展示基于其规则到底选中了哪些 Pod。你可以创建匹配规则和不匹配规则的 Pod，以验证 NetworkPolicy 的预期行为。

Visualizing network policies把 NetworkPolicy 可视化

Defining the rules of network policies correctly can be challenging. The page networkpolicy.io provides a visual editor for network policies that renders a graphical representation in the browser.

正确定义 NetworkPolicy 的规则可能颇具挑战。网页 networkpolicy.io 提供了一个 NetworkPolicy 可视化编辑器，能在浏览器中渲染出图形化表示。

As explained earlier, every Pod can talk to other Pods running on any node of the cluster, which exposes a potential security risk. An attacker able to gain access to a Pod theoretically can try to compromise another Pod by communicating with it by its virtual IP address.

如前所述，每个 Pod 都可以与集群任意节点上运行的其他 Pod 通信，这暴露了潜在的安全风险。理论上，攻击者一旦能访问某个 Pod，就可以尝试通过其虚拟 IP 地址与另一个 Pod 通信来攻陷它。

Applying Default Network Policies应用默认 NetworkPolicy

The principle of least privilege is a fundamental security concept, and it’s highly recommended when it comes to restricting Pod-to-Pod network traffic in Kubernetes. The idea is to initially disallow all traffic and then selectively open up only the necessary connections based on the application’s architecture and communication requirements.

最小权限原则是一个基本的安全概念，在限制 Kubernetes 中 Pod 间网络流量时强烈推荐使用。其思路是：最初禁止所有流量，然后根据应用的架构和通信需求，有选择地只开放必要的连接。

You can lock down Pod-to-Pod communication with the help of a default network policy. Default network policies are custom policies set up by administrators to enforce restrictive communication patterns by default.

你可以借助一条默认 NetworkPolicy 来锁定 Pod 间通信。默认 NetworkPolicy 是由管理员设置的自定义策略，用于默认实施限制性的通信模式。

— PDF p.286 —

To demonstrate the functionality of such a default network policy, we’ll set up two Pods in the namespace internal-tools. Within the namespace, all Pods will be able to communicate with each other:

为了演示这种默认 NetworkPolicy 的功能，我们在 namespace internal-tools 中设置两个 Pod。在该 namespace 内，所有 Pod 原本可以相互通信：

$ kubectl create namespace internal-tools
namespace/internal-tools created
$ kubectl run metrics-api --image=nginx:1.25.3-alpine --port=80 \
  -l app=api -n internal-tools
pod/metrics-api created
$ kubectl run metrics-consumer --image=nginx:1.25.3-alpine --port=80 \
  -l app=consumer -n internal-tools
pod/metrics-consumer created

Example 20-2 defines a default network policy that denies all ingress and egress network traffic in the namespace. We’ll store the network policy in the file networkpolicy-deny-all.yaml.

示例 20-2 定义了一条默认 NetworkPolicy，用于拒绝该 namespace 中所有的 ingress 和 egress 网络流量。我们把它存放在文件 networkpolicy-deny-all.yaml 中。

Example 20-2. Disallowing all traffic with the default policy

示例 20-2. 用默认策略禁止所有流量

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: internal-tools
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  • The curly braces for spec.podSelector mean “apply to all Pods in the namespace.”spec.podSelector 的花括号表示“作用于该 namespace 中的所有 Pod”。
  • Defines the types of traffic the rule should apply to, in this case ingress and egress traffic.定义该规则应作用的流量类型，本例为 ingress 和 egress 流量。

Create the network policy from the manifest:

从 manifest 创建 NetworkPolicy：

$ kubectl apply -f networkpolicy-deny-all.yaml
networkpolicy.networking.k8s.io/default-deny-all created

The network policy prevents any network communication between the Pods in the internal-tools namespace, as shown here:

该 NetworkPolicy 阻止了 internal-tools namespace 中 Pod 之间的任何网络通信，如下所示：

$ kubectl get pod metrics-api --template '{{.status.podIP}}' -n internal-tools
10.244.0.182
$ kubectl exec metrics-consumer -it -n internal-tools \
  -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.182
Connecting to 10.244.0.182 (10.244.0.182:80)
wget: download timed out
— PDF p.287 —
command terminated with exit code 1
$ kubectl get pod metrics-consumer --template '{{.status.podIP}}' \
  -n internal-tools
10.244.0.70
$ kubectl exec metrics-api -it -n internal-tools \
  -- wget --spider --timeout=1 10.244.0.70
Connecting to 10.244.0.70 (10.244.0.70:80)
wget: download timed out
command terminated with exit code 1

With those default deny constraints in place, you can define more detailed rules and loosen restrictions gradually. Network policies are additive. It’s common practice to now set up additional network policies that will open up directional traffic, but only the ones that are really required.

在这些默认拒绝的约束就位之后，你可以定义更详细的规则并逐步放宽限制。NetworkPolicy 是叠加的。常见做法是再设置一些额外的 NetworkPolicy，只开放真正需要的方向性流量。

Restricting Access to Specific Ports限制对特定端口的访问

Controlling access at the port level is a critical aspect of network security in Kubernetes. If not explicitly defined by a network policy, all ports are accessible, which can pose security risks. For instance, if you have an application running in a Pod that exposes port 80 to the outside world, leaving all other ports open widens the attack vectors unnecessarily. Port rules can be specified for ingress and egress as part of a network policy. The definition of a network policy in Example 20-3 allows access on port 80.

在端口层面控制访问是 Kubernetes 网络安全的关键方面。如果 NetworkPolicy 没有显式定义，所有端口都可访问，这会带来安全风险。例如，如果你在一个 Pod 中运行的应用向外部暴露了 80 端口，而让其他所有端口都开放，就会不必要地扩大攻击面。端口规则可以作为 NetworkPolicy 的一部分，分别为 ingress 和 egress 指定。示例 20-3 中的 NetworkPolicy 定义允许对 80 端口的访问。

Example 20-3. Definition of a network policy allowing ingress access on port 8080

示例 20-3. 允许在 8080 端口上进行 ingress 访问的 NetworkPolicy 定义

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: port-allow
  namespace: internal-tools
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: consumer
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80

Only allows incoming traffic on port 80

只允许 80 端口上的入站流量

When defining network policies, only allow those ports that are required for implementing your architectural needs. All other ports should be locked down.

定义 NetworkPolicy 时，只允许那些实现你架构需求所必需的端口，其他所有端口都应被锁定。

— PDF p.288 —

Summary本章小结

Inter-Pod communication or communication between two containers of the same Pod is completely unrestricted in Kubernetes. Network policies instate rules to control the network traffic either from or to a Pod. You can think of network policies as firewall rules for Pods. It’s best practice to start with a “deny all traffic” rule to minimize the attack vector.

在 Kubernetes 中，Pod 间通信、或同一 Pod 内两个容器之间的通信完全不受限制。NetworkPolicy 建立规则来控制进出某个 Pod 的网络流量。你可以把 NetworkPolicy 想象成 Pod 的防火墙规则。最佳实践是从“拒绝所有流量”的规则开始，以最小化攻击面。

From there, you can open access as needed. Learning about the intricacies of network policies requires a bit of hands-on practice, as it is not directly apparent if the rules work as expected.

在此基础上，再按需开放访问。了解 NetworkPolicy 的细微之处需要一些动手练习，因为规则是否按预期生效并不直观。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Understand the purpose and effects of network policies. By default, Pod-to-Pod communication is unrestricted. Instantiate a default deny rule to restrict Pod-to-Pod network traffic with the principle of least privilege. The attribute spec.podSelector of a network policy selects the target Pod the rules apply to based on label selection. The ingress and egress rules define Pods, namespaces, IP addresses, and ports for allowing incoming and outgoing traffic.理解 NetworkPolicy 的用途与效果。默认情况下 Pod 间通信不受限制；应实例化一条默认拒绝规则，按最小权限原则限制 Pod 间网络流量。NetworkPolicy 的 spec.podSelector 属性基于标签选择来选定规则所作用的目标 Pod。ingress 和 egress 规则定义允许入站和出站流量的 Pod、namespace、IP 地址和端口。
  • Know how to implement the principle of least privilege. Network policies can be aggregated. A default deny rule can disallow ingress and/or egress traffic. An additional network policy can open up those rules with a more fine-grained definition.了解如何实施最小权限原则。NetworkPolicy 是可聚合的：一条默认拒绝规则可以禁止 ingress 和/或 egress 流量；额外的 NetworkPolicy 可以用更细粒度的定义来开放这些规则。
  • Explore common network policy scenarios. To explore common scenarios, look at the GitHub repository named “Kubernetes Network Policy Recipes”. The repository comes with a visual representation for each scenario and walks you through the steps to set up the network policy and the involved Pods. This is a great practice resource.探索常见的 NetworkPolicy 场景。要探索常见场景，可以看 GitHub 上名为“Kubernetes Network Policy Recipes”的仓库。该仓库为每个场景提供了可视化表示，并带你一步步设置 NetworkPolicy 及相关 Pod，是很好的练习资源。
— PDF p.289 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. Your cluster has two teams working in separate namespaces. You need to implement network policies that control cross-namespace communication. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch20/cross-namespace-control of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create the objects from the YAML manifest setup.yaml. Inspect the objects in the namespaces team-alpha and team-beta. Create a NetworkPolicy in the team-alpha namespace that allows the alpha-app Pod to connect only to the team-beta namespace and denies all other egress traffic except DNS. Create a NetworkPolicy in the team-beta namespace that allows the beta-app Pod to receive traffic from team-alpha namespace on port 80 and denies all other ingress traffic. Test the policies to ensure that the alpha-app Pod can reach the beta-app Pod, the alpha-app Pod cannot reach external sites, and the beta-app Pod cannot receive traffic from other sources.你的集群中有两个团队在各自独立的 namespace 中工作。你需要实施 NetworkPolicy 来控制跨 namespace 通信。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch20/cross-namespace-control，从 YAML manifest setup.yaml 创建对象。检查 namespace team-alpha 和 team-beta 中的对象。在 team-alpha namespace 中创建一个 NetworkPolicy，允许 alpha-app Pod 只连接到 team-beta namespace，并拒绝除 DNS 之外的所有其他 egress 流量。在 team-beta namespace 中创建一个 NetworkPolicy，允许 beta-app Pod 在 80 端口接收来自 team-alpha namespace 的流量，并拒绝所有其他 ingress 流量。测试这些策略：确保 alpha-app Pod 能到达 beta-app Pod，alpha-app Pod 不能访问外部网站，beta-app Pod 不能接收来自其他来源的流量。
  2. You have a three-tier application with frontend, backend, and database components. You need to implement network policies to ensure only the backend Pod can access the database, while the frontend can only communicate with the backend Pod. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch20/database-access-control of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create the objects from the YAML manifest setup.yaml. Inspect the objects in the namespace production. Create a NetworkPolicy named database-policy that applies to Pods with label tier=database. It should only allow ingress from Pods with label tier=backend on port 6379. Create a NetworkPolicy named backend-policy that applies to Pods with label tier=backend. It should only allow ingress from Pods with label tier=frontend on port 80. Allow egress to Pods with label tier=database on port 6379. Allow DNS resolution on port 53. Create a default deny-all ingress policy for the production namespace. Verify your policies by testing connectivity: the frontend Pod should not be able to reach the database. The frontend Pod should be able to reach the backend Pod. The backend Pod should be able to reach the database Pod.你有一个三层应用，包含前端、后端和数据库组件。你需要实施 NetworkPolicy，确保只有后端 Pod 能访问数据库，而前端只能与后端 Pod 通信。进入已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中的目录 app-a/ch20/database-access-control，从 YAML manifest setup.yaml 创建对象。检查 namespace production 中的对象。创建名为 database-policy 的 NetworkPolicy，作用于标签为 tier=database 的 Pod，只允许来自标签为 tier=backend 的 Pod 在 6379 端口的 ingress。创建名为 backend-policy 的 NetworkPolicy，作用于标签为 tier=backend 的 Pod，只允许来自标签为 tier=frontend 的 Pod 在 80 端口的 ingress；允许 egress 到标签为 tier=database 的 Pod 的 6379 端口；允许 53 端口的 DNS 解析。为 production namespace 创建一条默认拒绝所有 ingress 的策略。通过测试连通性来验证你的策略：前端 Pod 不应能到达数据库，前端 Pod 应能到达后端 Pod，后端 Pod 应能到达数据库 Pod。
— PDF p.290 —
